title: Gas Leak Near Cigarroa Middle School Prompts Evacuation; Students Safely Return
excerpt: Students at Cigarroa Middle School were evacuated to the athletic field Tuesday morning after a gas leak was reported in the neighborhood across the street, and returned to class after the Laredo Fire Department cleared the school, according to the Laredo Morning Times.
content:
Students at Cigarroa Middle School were evacuated to the school's athletic field Tuesday morning after a gas leak was reported in a residential neighborhood across from the campus, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The Laredo Fire Department responded to the report and addressed the leak, according to the report. A Laredo Independent School District spokesperson said the evacuation was a precaution while firefighters worked on the problem.

The fire department cleared the school, and students have already returned to campus, the district spokesperson said.

No further information was immediately available about what caused the leak or exactly where in the neighborhood it was found, according to the report.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 17, 2026.
